summary: Trevi Therapeutics filed a prospectus supplement for a public offering of 11,600,000 shares of common stock. The public offering price is $13.00 per share, with underwriters including Morgan Stanley, Leerink Partners, Cantor, Stifel, and Oppenheimer. The filing is a routine follow-on offering under Rule 424(b)(5) and does not involve a special situation such as an acquisition or restructuring. It is an ordinary capital markets transaction to raise proceeds of approximately $141.8 million before expenses.
